sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (illustrations show ₹10L; range not stated)

room_rent.note: Default entitlement is Single Private AC Room. Optional Benefit 3.2.2 allows upgrade to Twin Sharing Room or No Limit for an additional premium.

icu.note: Policy explicitly states 'No limit' on ICU charges under base plan (Clause 3.1.1(ix)(iii)).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the base policy terms.

sub_limits.display: No sub-limits in Plan A base; Plan B adds cataract & room-rent sub-limit covers
sub_limits.note: Plan A (base) has no disease-wise sub-limits. Plan B is an optional top-up that uses base policy sub-limits (e.g. cataract, room rent proportionate charges) as deductibles. Optional Benefit 3.2.8 can impose a sub-limit on Advance Technology Methods.

deductible.note: Deductible is optional and chosen by the policyholder at inception (Plan A: aggregate basis; Plan B: per-claim basis). Illustrations show ₹2,00,000 as an example. No mandatory deductible.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional Benefit 3.2.6 (PED Wait Period Modification) can reduce this to a shorter period as specified in the Policy Schedule.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Named ailment waiting period is 24 months for listed conditions (e.g. cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.). Optional Benefit 3.2.7 can reduce this period.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are excluded under Permanent Exclusion Code Excl18. Ectopic pregnancy is also excluded. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of Sum Insured added per completed policy year; maximum cap is 100% of Sum Insured. No impact on bonus accrual even if a claim is made.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge reinstates up to the full base Sum Insured unlimited times per policy year once base SI is exhausted. Usable for same or different illnesses. Cumulative Bonus not included in recharge amount.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission, for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge. Claim documents to be submitted within 30 days after completion of 180 days from discharge.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered up to Sum Insured via cashless or reimbursement.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured if treatment exceeds 3 consecutive days. Certain diseases excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured for in-patient care at registered AYUSH hospitals within India.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's medical expenses for harvesting surgery covered up to Sum Insured. Pre/post-hospitalisation expenses for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to Sum Insured (no separate fixed cap stated). Deductible applicable. Air ambulance is an optional add-on (Benefit 3.2.4).

modern_treatments.display: Covered up to SI (12 listed methods)
modern_treatments.note: 12 advance technology methods listed (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, HIFU, etc.) covered under base plan up to Sum Insured. Optional Benefit 3.2.8 can impose a sub-limit on these.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items are listed in Annexure I as excluded. No optional consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Global Coverage (Optional Benefit 3.2.1) covers planned and emergency hospitalisation outside India up to Sum Insured specified in Policy Schedule. Restricted to in-patient care and day-care treatment only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Applies to original SI; fresh 5-year period starts on SI enhancement for enhanced portion.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all premium modes except monthly, where it is 15 days. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document. Applicable only on new policies, not renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, non-allopathic (except AYUSH inpatient), external prosthetics, hazardous sports (professional)

optional_riders.display: Global Coverage, Room Rent Modification (twin/no-limit), Daily Cash Allowance, Air Ambulance, International Second Opinion, PED Wait Reduction, Named Ailment Wait Reduction, ATM sub-limit, Unlimited Care (lifetime no-limit)
